Thematic tours: the Enlightenment, literature and Voltaire’s Geneva

For history lovers, literary societies and study trips: guided visits of the Château de Voltaire built around one theme, in English, French, German or Russian.

Every tour includes Voltaire’s gardens

Thematic guided tours in Ferney-Voltaire

A thematic tour follows one thread through the house, the park and the town. It is the best way to understand why a château near Geneva became one of the capitals of the European Enlightenment.

Each theme can be adapted for adults, students or specialists, and combined with the classic visit.

Request a Group Quote

Themes

Enlightenment history tour

From Ferney, Voltaire published Candide and the Treatise on Tolerance, and wrote thousands of letters to Catherine the Great, Frederick II and the thinkers of his time. An Enlightenment history tour of Ferney-Voltaire, room by room.

Voltaire and Geneva: a guided visit across the border

Before Ferney, Voltaire lived at Les Délices in Geneva. Discover why he settled just across the border, how his quarrels with Geneva over the theatre shaped that choice, and how the two cities still share his story.

Literary tour of the Château de Voltaire

For reading groups, students and literary societies: Voltaire the writer, his plays, his tales, his immense correspondence, and his library, which Catherine the Great bought after his death.

Life at the château and its gardens

The household, the guests, the theatre and the charmilles: the daily life of the “innkeeper of Europe” and the gardens he designed.

Ideal for

  • History and philosophy enthusiasts
  • Literary societies and reading groups
  • University and secondary-school study trips
  • Cultural associations and alumni groups
  • Visitors who already know the château

A custom thematic itinerary

Have a theme in mind: Voltaire and Russia, tolerance and justice, science, theatre? I build custom thematic itineraries for groups on request.

Questions about thematic tours

How long is a thematic tour?

Usually 75 to 90 minutes. Several themes can be combined in a longer visit.

Can a thematic tour be combined with Geneva?

Yes. The “Voltaire and Geneva” theme pairs naturally with a visit to Geneva, where his house Les Délices is now a museum.

Are thematic tours suitable for students?

Yes. I adapt the vocabulary and depth to each level, from secondary school to university.

Choose your theme

Tell me what interests your group: I will propose a thematic itinerary and a quote within 48 hours.
